assignment: Advise a school committee how to decide the next phase of two reading pilots.
source: School A gave tutoring to 20 volunteers and its mean reading score increased by 8 points. School B used classroom practice with 80 students and gained 5 points. A began 9 points lower. Different teachers marked the two follow-up tests. The district can fund a next-term pilot at four schools.

criteria.full: Reports the observed three-point gain difference and identifies baseline imbalance and volunteer selection.
criteria.partial: Compares gains but treats differently selected groups as equivalent.

criteria.full: Explains the marker difference and proposes common or blinded scoring with comparable assessments.
criteria.partial: Requests common tests without addressing marking.

criteria.full: Proposes a feasible balanced four-school comparison, including baseline measurement and implementation tracking.
criteria.partial: Expands to four schools without improving assignment or measurement.

criteria.full: Identifies a learning plus access or cost criterion and a review point before wider adoption.
criteria.partial: Recommends a winner solely from raw gains.
